workflow: 1. Add new patient (validation, LabId generation, save)
title: PatientService.CreateAsync — happy path with blank LabId auto-generates and persists
preconditions: OpenLabDbContext is initialized and empty of patients for today (yyyyMMdd prefix).
steps: Call PatientService.CreateAsync with the patient above and LabId left blank.
expected: Returned Patient.PatientId > 0; LabId matches pattern '^[0-9]{8}[0-9]{3}$' and starts with today's yyyyMMdd; GetByLabIdAsync returns a patient with the same FullName (trimmed) and normalized AgeUnit.

title: PatientService.CreateAsync — rejects missing FullName with ArgumentException
expected: ArgumentException with message containing 'FullName' is thrown; no row inserted in Patients.

title: PatientService.CreateAsync — rejects invalid Gender value
expected: ArgumentException ('Gender value is invalid'); allowed set is {Male, Female, ذكر, أنثى}.

title: PatientService.CreateAsync — rejects future BirthDate
expected: ArgumentException ('BirthDate cannot be in the future').

title: PatientService.CreateAsync — rejects unknown ReferralId
expected: InvalidOperationException ('Referral contract not found').

title: PatientService.CreateAsync — duplicate LabId rejected
steps: Attempt to insert another patient with the same LabId.
expected: Second insert throws InvalidOperationException ('LabId already exists'); only the first row persists.

title: PatientService.GenerateNextLabIdAsync — sequence resets per day and skips taken IDs
expected: First call returns 20260527004; second call returns 20260527005; LabId is unique on save.

title: PatientService.UpdateAsync — writes EDIT_PATIENT audit row when fields change
steps: Create a patient and capture PatientId.
Call UpdateAsync(patient, userId=42) changing Age, IsVip, HomePhone, Email.
Read AuditLogs filtered by Action='EDIT_PATIENT' and RecordId=PatientId.
expected: Exactly one new AuditLog row with OldValues != NewValues; the snapshot includes Age, AgeUnit, IsVip, IsPregnant, HomePhone, NationalId, Email (Phase 0 fix C-02).

title: PatientService.SaveRegistrationAsync — atomic Patient+Visit+VisitTests+Invoice commits together
steps: Construct a new Patient (PatientId=0), a Visit, two VisitTests, and one Invoice.
Read back rows from each table.
expected: Returns visitId > 0; all four rows present and linked by the same PatientId/VisitId; LabId auto-generated if blank.

title: PatientService.SaveRegistrationAsync — rollback when invoice fails
steps: Pass a Visit referencing a non-existent ReferralId so VisitService.CreateAsync (or the implicit FK) would throw; alternatively pass null for invoice via reflection on a test helper.
expected: Patients/Visits/VisitTests/Invoices tables are unchanged after the call (full rollback via EF Core BeginTransactionAsync).

title: PatientService.DeleteAsync — refuses to delete a patient with visits
expected: InvalidOperationException ('Cannot delete patient with visits'); row persists.

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.CreateAsync — creates Open visit and inherits ReferralId from patient
expected: Visit persisted; AccountType set to 'Referral'; ReferralId inherited from patient; Status='Open'.

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync — resolves price from referral price list
steps: Seed a referral price list with Test T at price 75.
Create a visit linked to that referral.
Call AddTestToVisitAsync(visitId, testId=T) with no overridePrice.
expected: VisitTest persisted with Price=75 and Status='Pending'.

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync — rejects duplicate tests on same visit
expected: Second call with the same (VisitId, TestId) throws InvalidOperationException ('Test already exists in this visit').

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync — rejects when visit is Closed
expected: InvalidOperationException ('Closed visits cannot accept new tests').

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync — send-out test enqueues on ExternalLabQueues
steps: Query ExternalLabQueues for the new VisitTestId.
expected: Exactly one ExternalLabQueue row with Status='Pending', ReferralId matching the visit, DateQueued ~ now.

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.RemoveVisitTestAsync — refuses removal once a result is entered
steps: Add a test to a visit.
Save a ResultValue with non-empty Value.
expected: InvalidOperationException ('Tests cannot be removed after result entry'); VisitTest stays.

workflow: 2. Assign lab tests to patient visit
title: VisitService.AddCustomGroupToVisitAsync — adds all group tests and skips duplicates
expected: Returned list contains exactly {A, C}; final VisitTests = {A,B,C}.

title: PatientRegistrationViewModel.ShowBarcode — refuses when both PatientId and LabId are missing
expected: StatusMessage = 'يجب حفظ المريض أو إدخال Lab ID قبل طباعة الباركود.'; barcodeDialogService.ShowBarcodeDialog NOT called.

title: ShowBarcode — fasting flag adds 'Serum Fasting' label as first entry
expected: BarcodeDialogData.SampleLabels = ['Serum Fasting', 'FBG', 'CBC'].

title: ShowBarcode — falls back to sample-type labels when no tests are selected
expected: SampleLabels = ['Blood', 'Urine'].

title: ShowBarcode — CaseCode prefers CASE-{VisitId} over PAT-{PatientId} over LabId
steps: Case A: PatientId=0, LabId='20260527007', CurrentVisitId=0 → expect CaseCode='20260527007'.
Case B: PatientId=5, LabId='20260527007', CurrentVisitId=0 → expect CaseCode='PAT-5'.
Case C: PatientId=5, LabId='20260527007', CurrentVisitId=12 → expect CaseCode='CASE-12'.
expected: Each case produces the listed CaseCode in the BarcodeDialogData passed to the dialog service.

title: PrintService.PrintBarcodeImageAsync — rejects blank title
expected: ArgumentException ('العنوان مطلوب.').

title: PatientRegistrationViewModel.PrintReceiptAsync — refuses when no visit is saved
expected: StatusMessage = 'لا توجد زيارة محفوظة أو خدمة الطباعة غير متاحة.'; IPrintService.PrintReceiptAsync NOT called.

title: PrintReceiptAsync — rebuilds ReceiptData from DB after a save
steps: Create a patient, visit, two visit tests, and an invoice via services.
Bind CurrentVisitId / PatientId on the VM.
expected: IPrintService.PrintReceiptAsync invoked once with ReceiptData whose Visit.VisitId == saved visit, VisitTests count == 2, Invoice.Total/Discount/NetTotal/Paid/Balance match DB values, and barcodeText == LabId.

title: PrintReceiptAsync — falls back to in-memory state when IVisitService is null
steps: Instantiate VM with visitService=null but printService non-null.
expected: PrintReceiptAsync invoked once; ReceiptData.VisitTests built from SelectedTests; Invoice.Total == TotalAmount, Discount == DiscountAmount, Balance == BalanceForLab, Status=='Closed' when BalanceForLab<=0 else 'Open'.

title: PrintService.PrintReceiptAsync — null data throws ArgumentNullException
expected: ArgumentNullException('data').

title: PatientRegistrationViewModel.PrintWorksheetAsync — refuses when no tests are selected
expected: StatusMessage = 'لا توجد تحاليل مختارة لطباعة ورقة العمل.'; IPrintService.PrintWorksheetByPatientAsync NOT called.

title: PrintWorksheetAsync — uses DB count when a visit is saved
steps: Create a visit with 3 visit tests in DB.
expected: PrintWorksheetByPatientAsync invoked with rows[0].TestsCount == 3 (DB) even though SelectedTests.Count == 0 (G4.4).

title: PrintService.PrintWorksheetByPatientAsync — empty rows renders 'no data' line
expected: Underlying FlowDocument contains a paragraph with text 'لا توجد بيانات.'; print job name is 'WorksheetByPatient'.

title: PrintWorksheetByTestAsync — rows sorted by Count desc then TestName asc
expected: Output order: HbA1c(7), CBC(5), FBG(5).

title: ResultsService.SaveResultAsync — single-component test transitions VisitTest to Completed
steps: Create a test with zero TestParameters and add it to a visit (VisitTest status='Pending').
Call SaveResultAsync(visitTestId, parameterId=0, value='6.5', flag=null, comment=null).
expected: ResultValue row inserted; VisitTest.Status='Completed' (any value is enough when no parameters exist).

title: SaveResultAsync — multi-component test stays InProgress until every parameter has a value
steps: Create a CBC test with 3 parameters {WBC, RBC, HGB}.
expected: Status transitions Pending → InProgress → InProgress → Completed; three ResultValue rows persisted; each has Value set and VerifiedBy/VerifiedAt null.

title: SaveResultAsync — refuses to write to a Verified VisitTest
expected: InvalidOperationException ('Verified results are locked. Reopen first.').

title: SaveResultAsync — writes EDIT_RESULT audit when an existing value changes
steps: Save again with value 8.0 and userId=10.
expected: Exactly one EDIT_RESULT row; OldValues contains 'Value=7.5'; NewValues contains 'Value=8.0'.

title: ResultsService.VerifyVisitTestAsync — requires every parameter to have a value
steps: CBC test with 3 parameters; save values for only 2.
expected: InvalidOperationException ('All parameters must have values before verification.'); VisitTest.Status unchanged.

title: VerifyVisitTestAsync — sets VerifiedBy/VerifiedAt and flips status to Verified
expected: All ResultValues have VerifiedBy=userId and VerifiedAt~now (within 5s); VisitTest.Status='Verified'.

title: ResultsService.ReopenVisitTestAsync — clears verification metadata and resets status to InProgress
expected: All ResultValues for the test have VerifiedBy=null and VerifiedAt=null; VisitTest.Status='InProgress'.

title: ResultsService.ValidateResultAsync — picks parameter-scoped range over test-wide range
steps: Seed test T with two ranges: one with ParameterId=null Low=0 High=20, and one with ParameterId=P Low=4 High=10.
Call ValidateResultAsync(testId=T, parameterId=P, value='15', gender='Male', age=30, ageUnit='Year').
expected: Flag='H'; HighThreshold=10 (param-specific range wins); LowThreshold=4.

title: ValidateResultAsync — matches gender-specific and age-bracketed range
steps: Seed ranges for testId=T: (Gender=null,Low=4,High=10) and (Gender='Female', AgeFromDays=0, AgeToDays=18*365, Low=3.5, High=6).
Call ValidateResultAsync(testId=T, value='4', gender='Female', age=10, ageUnit='Year').
expected: Flag=null (in-range); HighThreshold=6 (gender-specific range wins via OrderByDescending(r=>r.Gender!=null)).

title: ValidateResultAsync — non-numeric value returns no thresholds
input: value='Positive', range exists with Low/High numerical
expected: Result.NumericValue is null/0; Flag is null; HighThreshold/LowThreshold left at default; DefaultComment still populated if a TestComment exists.

title: GetPreviousResultAsync — returns most recent prior visit-test with a value
steps: Patient P has three visits with the same Test T: visit1 has values, visit2 has empty results, visit3 has values.
expected: Returns visit1's VisitTest (most recent prior with a non-empty ResultValue).

title: PatientService.SearchAsync — partial name match (case-sensitive Contains)
expected: Returns ['Ahmed Said', 'Ahmad Saad'] ordered by FullName.

title: SearchAsync — phone substring match
expected: Returns only patients whose Phone contains '1234'; null-phone rows excluded.

title: SearchAsync — date filter returns only patients with a visit on that day
steps: Patient P1 has a visit on 2026-05-27; P2 has a visit on 2026-05-26; P3 has no visits.
expected: Returns only [P1].

title: SearchAsync — combined name + phone + labId narrows progressively
expected: Returns only [A].

title: PatientService.GetByLabIdAsync — trims input and is exact match
expected: Returns the patient; calling with '202605270' (prefix) returns null (StartsWith is not used here, only equality after Trim).

title: GetByLabIdAsync — empty/whitespace labId throws ArgumentException
expected: ArgumentException with paramName='labId'.

title: PatientRegistrationViewModel.LoadTodayPatientsAsync — populates QuickPatientsList from today's visits
steps: Seed three patients with visits today and one with a visit yesterday.
expected: QuickPatientsList.Count == 3; IsQuickPatientsListVisible == true; StatusMessage contains 'مرضى اليوم: 3'.

title: Concurrent SaveRegistrationAsync calls do not produce duplicate LabIds
steps: Run 10 SaveRegistrationAsync tasks in parallel each with LabId=null for today.
Await all tasks and read back Patients.
expected: Exactly 10 patients persisted with 10 distinct LabIds matching today's yyyyMMdd prefix; no row left orphaned in Visits/VisitTests/Invoices on any failure.
